THE EAST AFRICAN COMMUNITY COMPETITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023.
An Act of the Community to amend the East African
Community Competition Act, 2006 to streamline the
provisions on mergers with the international practice on
competition; to confer legal personality on the Authority;
to empower the Authority to impose and collect financial
penalties; and provide for related matters.
Date of assent: 24th November, 2023
Date of Commencement: 31st December, 2024
ENACTED by the East African Community and assented to
by the Heads of State.
1. This Act may be cited as the East African Community Short title.
